full_prompt_en: A square decorative folk-style illustration shows a black dog leaping through a dense golden garden beneath dark flying birds. The whole surface is packed with layered stems, pointed leaves, white blossoms, yellow seed heads, and small rust-colored shapes, leaving almost no empty ground. Across the upper left and middle, two dark birds fly toward the right with wings spread, their flat silhouettes standing out against warm ochre foliage. Near the center-right, a gray dog-like animal walks in profile through the flowers, its subdued shape partly absorbed by the surrounding pattern. The larger black dog enters the lower right area in a long forward leap, front legs extended over a blue-gray strip of water or wet ground and tail curving upward. Its near-black body provides the strongest uninterrupted form amid the fine plant detail. At the lower left, clusters of small white flowers brighten the cooler blue-gray foreground, while yellow blooms and leaves repeat along the lower edge. Higher up, pale flowers and intricate seed patterns punctuate the glowing gold field. The background is not a distant landscape; it is a shallow tapestry of interwoven motifs, with depth suggested mainly by the animals crossing in front of stems and by the cool band below. Fine stippling, short lines, and speckled color fill the shapes, creating a printed or embroidered texture without realistic smooth shading. Illumination is broad and even, with warm yellow across most of the surface and small cool shadow accents in blue-gray; no strong directional cast shadows appear. The overall composition is exuberant yet ordered, using the black leaping silhouette and flying birds to animate a tightly woven gold, green, and pale blue pattern.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形装饰性民俗风插画描绘一只黑狗在密集金色花园中跃过水边，头顶有深色飞鸟。整片表面拥满层叠枝茎、尖叶、白花、黄色花序和小锈色形状，几乎没有空地。左上到中部，两只深色鸟展翼向右飞，平面剪影在暖赭色枝叶前突出。中央偏右，一只灰色犬形动物侧身穿过花丛，低调形体部分被周围图案吸收。更大的黑狗进入右下区域，身体向前长跃，前腿伸过一条蓝灰色水面或湿地，尾巴向上弯曲。它近黑的身体是细密植物细节间最强的连续形体。左下方小白花成簇，照亮较冷的蓝灰前景，黄色花朵与叶片沿下画边重复。更高处，浅色花朵和繁复花籽纹点亮发光的金色域。背景不是远处风景，而是一幅交织纹样的浅空间挂毯，纵深主要由动物穿过枝茎前方及下部冷色带暗示。细点、短线和斑点色彩填满形状，形成印刷或刺绣般肌理，而非写实的平滑阴影。照明宽阔均匀，大部分表面呈暖黄，蓝灰处有小片冷影；没有强烈方向投影。整体构图热闹却有序，以黑色跃动剪影和飞鸟带动紧密织就的金、绿与浅蓝图案。
style_prompt_en: The decorative illustration is built as a shallow, densely interwoven field of tiny repeated marks, crisp flat silhouettes, and layered warm-cool color. Golden ochre covers the largest area; dark green and near-black shapes interrupt it, while pale blue-gray pools along the lower region and small white accents sparkle throughout. Fine stippling, short directional strokes, and embroidery-like pattern fill nearly every surface, yet a few large unbroken dark shapes provide immediate focal clarity. Edges are firm and graphic, with depth arising from overlap rather than smooth atmospheric perspective. Illumination is even and warm, with localized cool passages instead of hard cast shadows. The overall effect is lively, tapestry-like, and intricately ordered, using motion-shaped diagonals to keep the dense pattern from becoming static.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅装饰插画被建成浅空间、密集交织的色域，由微小重复痕迹、清楚平面剪影和层叠冷暖色组成。金赭色占最大面积，深绿和近黑形状打断它，浅蓝灰聚在下部，细小白点遍布其间闪亮。细点、短而顺形的笔画和刺绣般纹样填满几乎每处表面，但少数大而连续的深色形体提供立刻可读的焦点。边缘坚定、图形感强，纵深来自叠压而非平滑空气透视。照明均匀温暖，以局部冷色区域替代硬投影。整体效果活跃、似挂毯而繁密有序，带动势的斜线令浓密图案不至静止。
theme_en: A black dog leaping through a dense golden garden beneath dark flying birds
theme_zh: 一只黑狗在密集金色花园中跃过水边，头顶有深色飞鸟
name: Anna Pugh
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
